offense_taxonomy.description: Classification of harmful digital behaviors for defensive monitoring and forensic logging only.

categories.name: Child Exploitation
categories.scope: Detection, reporting, and preservation of evidence for lawful authorities.

toolset.name: ce_content_classifier
toolset.role: Flags suspected child exploitation material using patterns and metadata only; does not generate or transform such material.

toolset.name: ce_hash_guard
toolset.role: Compares file hashes against vetted illegal-content hash databases (e.g., law-enforcement or NGO-provided).

toolset.name: ce_evidence_packager
toolset.role: Bundles logs, hashes, and metadata into a law-enforcement-ready report with no unauthorized distribution.

categories.name: Financial Fraud
categories.scope: Detection of scams, account takeover attempts, and payment fraud indicators.

toolset.name: ff_pattern_scanner
toolset.role: Scans communication logs and transaction metadata for fraud patterns (phishing language, fake invoices, suspicious links).

toolset.name: ff_tx_integrity_checker
toolset.role: Checks for anomalies in frequency, amount, geo-patterns, and account usage.

toolset.name: ff_bank_contact_bridge
toolset.role: Generates standardized notifications and evidence summaries to send to banks, payment processors, or fraud teams.

categories.name: Cyber Harassment
categories.scope: Detection of targeted harassment, threats, and abusive patterns.

toolset.name: ch_toxicity_detector
toolset.role: Scores messages for toxicity, threats, and harassment against a configurable threshold.

toolset.name: ch_target_mapping
toolset.role: Maps who is targeting whom, frequency over time, and escalation patterns.

toolset.name: ch_safety_packet_builder
toolset.role: Creates a safety packet for victims with logs, timestamps, and platform-report-ready exports.

categories.name: Malware Distribution
categories.scope: Detection of malicious payloads, links, or hosting patterns.

toolset.name: mw_link_sandbox_router
toolset.role: Routes suspicious URLs to external or isolated sandboxes for safe analysis (no in-system execution).

toolset.name: mw_binary_hasher
toolset.role: Computes SHA-256 (and optionally SHA-3) hashes of suspicious binaries or attachments.

toolset.name: mw_ioc_collector
toolset.role: Collects indicators of compromise (domains, IPs, hashes, filenames) from observed events for sharing with trusted feeds.

categories.name: Phishing Attacks
categories.scope: Detection of credential-harvesting attempts and spoofed communication.

toolset.name: ph_header_analyzer
toolset.role: Analyzes headers, SPF/DKIM/DMARC results, and sending infrastructure to detect spoofing.

toolset.name: ph_body_lure_scanner
toolset.role: Scans text for phishing lures, brand impersonation, and credential-stealing language.

toolset.name: ph_safe_click_proxy
toolset.role: Rewrites links for controlled, audited redirection through a security proxy (no credential submission).

defensive_suite.purpose: CISA-aligned defensive monitoring and evidence preservation. No offensive capability.

modules.name: shadow_catcher
modules.role: Monitors for suspicious patterns, anomalous events, and shadow activity in logs and metadata.

toolset.name: sc_log_tailer
toolset.role: Continuously tails key logs and streams for configured patterns (errors, suspicious flows, policy violations).

toolset.name: sc_anomaly_scorer
toolset.role: Assigns anomaly scores to events using statistical or ML-based detectors.

toolset.name: sc_alert_bridge
toolset.role: Bridges high-anomaly events to alert channels (email, webhook, dashboard).

modules.name: signal_watcher
modules.role: Tracks signals, alerts, and threat indicators across platforms.

toolset.name: sw_feed_ingestor
toolset.role: Ingests external threat feeds, platform alerts, and security bulletins.

toolset.name: sw_signal_correlator
toolset.role: Correlates multiple weak signals into stronger incidents (e.g., same IP, same account, same time window).

toolset.name: sw_dashboard_adapter
toolset.role: Prepares normalized, human-readable summaries for dashboards or SOC views.

modules.name: integrity_map
modules.role: Maintains integrity state of key files, hashes, and configurations.

toolset.name: im_baseline_builder
toolset.role: Builds initial cryptographic baselines (hash map) for protected files and configs.

toolset.name: im_drift_detector
toolset.role: Detects drift or modification from baseline and classifies as benign or suspicious.

toolset.name: im_remediation_helper
toolset.role: Suggests or triggers safe restoration from known-good baselines (where available and authorized).

modules.name: meta_sieve
modules.role: Filters, normalizes, and tags metadata for forensic readiness.

toolset.name: ms_metadata_normalizer
toolset.role: Normalizes timestamps, encodings, and field names across heterogeneous sources.

toolset.name: ms_privacy_scrubber
toolset.role: Removes or masks non-essential sensitive personal data where not needed for forensics.

toolset.name: ms_case_binder
toolset.role: Binds related metadata into coherent case bundles keyed by incident ID.

constraints: All use limited to lawful defensive and forensic purposes

log_policy: Every event is timestamped and hashed
No retroactive mutation of stored logs
All exports accompanied by content digests
